title: Relayed announces can grow Node peer_db without bound
description: Security review of python/src/lichen/node.py found add_peer and constructor peer_db canonicalization have no capacity limit. _process_announce adds every valid relayed originator, so one admitted neighbor can relay arbitrarily many self-signed identities and drive unbounded Python memory plus O(n) native next-hop scans; peer_lookup_all then also exceeds LinkLayer's bounded candidate contract. Apply a deterministic bounded admission/eviction policy aligned with the link trust-store capacity, protect peers with live security/routing state, fail closed when no safe eviction exists, and test an authenticated announce flood.
